# EEcalc

> Local-first electronics / RF calculators (static site). Every calculator is controllable by an AI agent
> running in the page through `window.eeCalc` (JavaScript), URL inputs and a JSON results mirror.
> Full guide: ./ai.html

## How to drive it

- Open the site (https://funeetools.github.io/EEcalc/). Routes: `#/<category>/<slug>`, e.g. `#/rf/microstrip-impedance`.
- Inputs can be given in the URL: `#/rf/microstrip-impedance?solveFor=w&z0=50&h=0.508mm&er=3.66`
- In JavaScript (Playwright/Puppeteer `page.evaluate`, a browser extension, DevTools):
  - `eeCalc.listCalculators({status:'ready'})`
  - `await eeCalc.describe('rf/microstrip-impedance')` → inputs (paths, SI units, unit choices, limits), solve-for options, outputs, graphs
  - `await eeCalc.compute('rf/microstrip-impedance', {solveFor:'w', z0:50, h:'0.508 mm', er:3.66})` → results (headless, page untouched)
  - `await eeCalc.setInputs(id, values, {open:true})` → updates the visible page
  - `await eeCalc.getGraphData(id, graphId, {format:'csv'})`
  - Other versions of a calculator have ids `<id>@<key>` (e.g. `power/voltage-divider@basic`), listed under `versions` by `listCalculators` and `otherVersions` by `describe`; every call accepts them.
  - Workbook (the user's saved calculations in this browser): `eeCalc.getWorkbook()`, `await eeCalc.saveCalculation(id?, name?)`, `await eeCalc.loadSaved(savedIdOrName)`
- The latest results of the open calculator are mirrored as JSON in `<script id="ee-report" type="application/json">`.

## Ready calculators

- rf/microstrip-impedance — Z₀, εeff, dispersion, loss; solve for W, H, εr or Z₀
- rf/noise-figure-cascade — Friis NF, gain, IP3, sensitivity; solve a stage's max NF
- rf/smith-chart — Γ/VSWR/RL from Z or S11, line rotation, L-network matching
- signal/filter-designer — Butterworth/Chebyshev LC ladders, LP/HP/BP/BS, min order, E-series
- power/inrush-overshoot — hot-plug inrush and capacitor overshoot (RLC ODE)
